# AI 手记 / AI Notes

> 技术让事情变快，我想让它们仍然有意义。 Technology makes things faster. I want them to still mean something. 作者 / Author: Leen Ma，CC BY 4.0。

- 系列首页 / Series home: https://leenlbma.github.io/ai-notes/ · https://leenlbma.github.io/ai-notes/en/

## 文章（中文）

- [02 · 我理解的“AI 时代虚无主义”](https://leenlbma.github.io/ai-notes/posts/02-ai-nihilism/): 从《博德之门3》的修改器说起：当 AI 让创造变得廉价，我们究竟热爱创造，还是热爱自己比别人更擅长创造？
- [01 · 仍然是一个亲手创造东西的人](https://leenlbma.github.io/ai-notes/posts/01-still-building-by-hand/): 2026 年的 AI 手记：创造的成本、Demo 与交付、个人与组织效率、经验与人才，以及自己究竟想做什么。

## Posts (English)

- [01 · Still Someone Who Builds Things by Hand](https://leenlbma.github.io/ai-notes/posts/01-still-building-by-hand/en/): Notes on AI in 2026: the cost of creating, demos vs. delivery, individual vs. organizational speed, experience and talent, and what I really want to do.
